title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode6 Strange Producer

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow! All these tiny robots are scuttling around him!
Once upon a time there was an eccentric alchemist.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And those look like...drones?
That's a modern take on puppet theater...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh! They're flying now!
Thanks to the wonders of alchemy, he lived a life free of worries, but that made the common townsfolk envious.
One day, a traveling theater group visited the town. The alchemist took a peek at the show and saw that it made the townsfolk very happy. It was then that he made a decision.
He decided that he too wanted to stage marvelous shows that everyone would enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm like that too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Using robots and drones in a show for kids is pretty out there, but what he's doing is certainly impressive.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The narration is well-paced, and his gestures are expressive. He skillfully manages to make the audience sympathize with the robots, too!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Could he have created this performance entirely by himself? If so, I want him as our stage director!)
The alchemist came up with his own ideas, and rehearsed them alone, trying to match the performance of the traveling theater troupe.

Eventually, he invited the townsfolk to see his show.
And when they did—

rows.Speaker: Security Staff's Voice
rows.Line: YOU AGAIN!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm?
Oh dear. It seems we're due for an unscheduled intermission. We'll continue the story some other time!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Kids
rows.Line: Nooo!

Was the alchemist's show a success?
For now, I shall leave that to your imagination!

rows.Speaker: Security Staff
rows.Line:
Stop right there! *Huff*...
He always gives me the slip!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excuse me, but was that guy not a park employee?

rows.Speaker: Security Staff
rows.Line: No. He comes here to stage unauthorized performances. He makes himself scarce whenever I warn him, but keeps coming back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
When can I hear the rest of the story?
I want to know if the townsfolk liked the alchemist's show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, did you already forget what we were doing?
We were supposed to be looking for new members for our troupe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He would've been a good pick, though.)
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh... We searched the entire park for members who'd like to join us, but to no avail.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: What's up, Tsukasa? You got that job at Phoenix Wonderland, right? How was your first day?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I encountered a monster who couldn't be reasoned with, got teleported to another world, and was threatened by a fiendish mascot!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Um... Is that a play?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If only that'd been just a play...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By the way, have you ever seen a guy doing shows with robots anywhere around here?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: So you've finally lost it, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How rude! I'm perfectly sane!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Come on, though, shows with robots?
Hmm... Wait a minute...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh? You know someone who fits the bill?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: There's this guy who transferred to the class next door recently. Rui Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: He must be smart, because he transferred from an elite high school, but he's a bit of a weirdo. He brings all these machines to school and does shows out in the street and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tell me everything you know!
After school

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To think he was hiding right under my nose this whole time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hi, I'm Tsukasa Tenma from Class A.
I'm looking for Rui Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Student From Class B
rows.Line: Rui? He's gone off somewhere. I don't know where.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So I just missed him... Can you at least tell me where he usually hangs out? Or could I leave a message for him?

rows.Speaker: Student From Class B
rows.Line: Sorry but I don't want to have anything to do with him. He whispers to himself and chuckles during classes like he's crazy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The more I learn about him, the more he seems like an oddball. Well, I'll have a look around the school, and maybe I'll find him.
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
He wasn't in the courtyard, or the cafeteria.
This is the last place I could think of.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh... But the only people who hang out on the rooftop at this hour are couples and weirdos...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hey there, Tsukasa. I've been waiting for you to show up. You wanted to talk to me about something?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've been watching you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? Don't tell me you're...a fan?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fan? Hehe, it's interesting that that's the conclusion you jumped to.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You might say I'm a fan of yours.
Look up, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?! Is that a drone?
Is that what you meant when you said you've been watching me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, indeed. It amused me to see you running all over school, looking for me. I couldn't resist having my drone follow you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's got a camera and a mic?! Did you make this thing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I did indeed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And the robots at the show you did yesterday?
Did you make those too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, you saw my show?
I wasn't aware that you were one of MY fans.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I didn't come here as a fan. I'm here to offer you an invitation!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To what?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll get to the point, I want you to make shows with me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is that right? Hmm, that's not an unappealing idea.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I knew you'd agree!
Okay, now that I have you on board—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It seems we share a penchant for theater.
I wish you the best of luck, Tsukasa. Let's meet again some other time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, what?
